0022600186.text: The Miami Heat (2-5, 4th in the Southeast and 2 games back, 10th in the East) visit the LA Clippers (1-6, 4th in the Pacific and 4.5 games back, 13th in the West) with the Heat coming off a loss and sitting 1-2 on the road, while the Clippers have dropped six straight. Giannis Antetokounmpo is listed as day-to-day with a wrist sprain and is a game-time decision for Miami, while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Heat won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 140-123 victory in Miami on December 1, 2025.
